_about: Schema for data/name_roster.json (gitignored — holds real names). Used by the m9a-family-names detector and the familyfix fixer; edited through the /roster page (add-only; validated before every save). 'people' feeds the phonetic layer: each canonical spelling is matched against transcript tokens by Double Metaphone codes (primary + secondary). 'circle' says who the person is to the family ('family' | 'friend', default family) — real people beyond the household live here too, treated identically. 'nicknames' are FULL legitimate name forms (2026-07-03): correct as heard (never flagged, never rewritten), their sound codes join the matching layer, and a garbled nickname is corrected toward the nickname as spoken — never silently promoted to the canonical. 'aliases' is the opposite: known DISTORTIONS to catch exactly ('token' is the CLEANED form — lowercased, punctuation and possessive stripped); an alias whose own codes already reach a canonical or nickname is redundant and rejected at load time.
